title: Bis-thiosemicarbazone functions as a selective chemosensor with the lowest LOD for Hg ions in water-rich medium: implications for on-site detection and logic gate experiments
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29291-29304
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02561G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sanyog Sharma, Nabajyoti Patra, Navdeep Kaur, Pratap Kumar Pati, Sanjay Mandal, P. V. Bharatam, Tarlok Singh Lobana
In this investigation, a mesitylene-anchored bis-thiosemicarbazone (TOMH), was utilized as a chemosensor for the selective detection of mercury ions in an aqueous medium, among various metal ions.
